intent: Prevent unavailable fresh native progress from borrowing earlier cancellation-target success while preserving independently observed model-open and presented playback cancellation
repair: Both cancellation polling and final admission consume a fresh nullable native progress snapshot through the same production helper.
Unavailable or inactive native progress cannot qualify a prior PREPARING/SYNTHESIS observation. Cancellation still stops the production output and retains measured stop and retirement requirements.
Model opening is observed independently before a native handle exists; that interval ends at engine readiness, synthesis attempt entry or native failure.
PLAYBACK keeps independently observed first-presented-audio evidence, and terminal receipts cannot admit a new cancellation target.

baseline.qualification: Exact 8fd behavior with a semantic-preserving extraction of currentProgress?.let(executionProgress) followed by cached reached(target); production callers use that extracted helper. New tests are byte-identical to the corrected run.

controls: Fresh active inference accepted before unavailable final observation
Native PREPARING followed by null refused after engine readiness
Pre-handle model-open cancellation remains validated without native progress
Presented-audio playback cancellation remains validated without native progress
Measured 7 ms stop and completed retirement remain necessary for validation
regression.source_and_dependency_binding: 26 actual repository source snapshots and 12 pinned dependency files; exact enum/model constants are extracted. Only VoiceSpeechPlaybackResult changed between baseline and corrected source sets. All source hashes remained stable during both runs.

boundaries: Exact interface fragments for KokoroOutput, VoiceReplyPlayback, chunks.
Actual latest benchmark models, runners, parser/export, store, native factory and output compiled together. No Android behavior or device timing is claimed by compilation.

independent_review.scope: Both production call sites, fresh snapshot admission, model-open and playback independence, terminal guard, and exact source/dependency/excerpt/log proof binding. No reviewer test rerun.

qualification_limits: Focused host execution qualifies the measurement and report policy, not actual Android playback or device timings.
Android subset compile uses declared model-store, diagnostic and logging ports and extracted interface fragments; full ViewModel/Compose integration remains for exact combined-head CI.
No physical CPU/GPU/NPU benchmark, native performance improvement or acoustic latency is claimed.
Existing 8fd combined-head CI and publication holds remain outside this narrow repair.
mutations_excluded: Full Gradle builds and memory-policy changes
